map.4 只 50 mm 吸盘的流量估算: Flow estimate for four 50 mm suction cups
map.→ 打开真空发生器流量计算工具: -> Open the vacuum generator flow calculator tool
map.单吸盘面积 A = π·d² ÷ 4；真空压差 ΔP = 真空度% × 1013: Single suction cup area A = π·d²/4; vacuum pressure difference ΔP = vacuum% × 101325; holding force per cup F = A·ΔP; total holding force F_total = n·F; safe holding force F_safe = F_total / SF; holding volume V = A × 0.003 × n; required flow Q = V / t (converted to L/min); recommended flow = Q × 1.1
map.吸盘唇口、管路接头与工件表面都存在微小泄漏，实际抽气量要大于理论吸附容积除以时间: The lip of the suction cup, the pipe joints and the workpiece surface all leak slightly, so the actual pumping rate must exceed the theoretical holding volume divided by the time; the tool therefore applies a leakage margin of 1.1 by default.
map.安全系数该取多少？: What safety factor should I use?
map.快节拍产线设计：在目标响应时间约束下估算所需抽气流量，越短响应时间对应越大流量。: Fast-takt line design: estimate the required extraction flow under a target response time constraint, since a shorter response time means a larger flow.
map.推荐流量为什么要乘 1.1？: Why is the recommended flow multiplied by 1.1?
map.校核现有吸盘阵列：输入吸盘数量与真空度，检查安全吸附力是否满足负载并预留安全系数: Check an existing suction cup array: enter the number of cups and the vacuum level, and verify the safe holding force meets the load with a safety factor reserved.
map.水平搬运一般取 2 以上，垂直提升或高速运动取 3~4，防止冲击、振动与漏气导致: For horizontal handling a safety factor of 2 or more is normal; for vertical lifting or high-speed motion use 3-4 to prevent shock, vibration and air leakage from dropping the part. If the workpiece surface is rough or oily it must be increased further.
map.由吸盘直径、吸盘数量、真空度、供气压力、安全系数与目标响应时间，计算单/总吸附力: From the cup diameter, number of cups, vacuum level, supply pressure, safety factor and target response time, compute the per-cup and total holding force, the required extraction flow and the recommended vacuum generator size, supporting vacuum handling system selection.
map.真空发生器流量计算 使用指南: How to use the vacuum generator flow calculator
map.真空发生器由压缩空气经拉瓦尔喷管驱动，理论极限约 −90 kPa，实际多在 −6: A vacuum generator is driven by compressed air through a Laval nozzle, with a theoretical limit around -90 kPa and in practice -60 to -85 kPa. Enter the actual vacuum gauge reading; the tool counts up to no more than 95%.
map.真空发生器能达到多大真空度？: How much vacuum can a vacuum generator reach?
map.真空吸盘搬运系统选型：由工件重量与吸盘规格反推所需吸附力与抽气流量，匹配真空发生: Selection of a vacuum cup handling system: back-calculate the required holding force and extraction flow from the workpiece weight and the cup size, and match a vacuum generator.
map.真空吸盘选型：由吸盘直径求受力面积，真空度换算为压差（一个大气压 101325: Vacuum cup selection: get the working area from the cup diameter, convert the vacuum level into a pressure difference (one atmosphere is 101325 Pa), multiply by the area for the holding force per cup and by the number of cups for the total, then divide by the safety factor to get the usable safe holding force. The required extraction flow is estimated from the holding volume compressed by 3 mm divided by the target response time, then multiplied by a pipe leakage margin of 1.1, to match the vacuum generator size; if the load approaches the safe holding force, increase the cup diameter or the number of cups.
map.管径计算（重力流/压力流）: Pipe diameter calculation (gravity flow / pressure flow)
map.：吸盘直径 50 mm × 4 只、真空度 60%、供气压力 0.5 MPa、安: : 4 suction cups of 50 mm diameter, 60% vacuum, 0.5 MPa supply, safety factor 2 and a target response of 0.5 s: cup area ≈ 19.6 cm2, vacuum pressure difference ΔP = 0.6 x 101.325 ≈ 60.8 kPa, holding force per cup ≈ 119.4 N (about 12.2 kgf), total holding force ≈ 478 N (about 48.7 kgf), safe holding force ≈ 239 N (about 24.4 kgf); total holding volume ≈ 23.6 cm3, required flow ≈ 2.83 L/min, and with the leakage margin the recommendation is ≈ 3.1 L/min.
